Click-through rate (CTR)

Recorded ad clicks ÷ recorded ad impressions × 100

  • support.google.com · Reference 1 ↗
Read the definition & analysis →

Average cost per click (CPC)

Media cost associated with recorded clicks ÷ recorded ad clicks

  • support.google.com · Reference 1 ↗
Read the definition & analysis →

Cost per thousand impressions (CPM)

Media spend ÷ recorded impressions × 1,000

  • support.google.com · Reference 1 ↗
  • developers.google.com · Reference 2 ↗
Read the definition & analysis →

Media cost per lead (CPL)

Attributed media spend ÷ unique valid attributed leads

  • developers.google.com · Reference 1 ↗
  • hubspot.com · Reference 2 ↗
Read the definition & analysis →

Media cost per qualified lead (CPQL)

Attributed media spend ÷ unique attributed leads meeting the agreed qualification criteria

  • blog.hubspot.com · Reference 1 ↗
  • developers.google.com · Reference 2 ↗
Read the definition & analysis →

Media-only customer acquisition cost

Attributed media spend ÷ new paying customers attributed to that media

  • stripe.com · Reference 1 ↗
  • support.google.com · Reference 2 ↗
Read the definition & analysis →

Lead-to-customer conversion

Leads in the cohort becoming paying customers within the window ÷ unique valid leads in that cohort × 100

  • hubspot.com · Reference 1 ↗
Read the definition & analysis →

Lead qualification rate

Unique cohort leads reaching the qualified stage ÷ unique valid leads entering the preceding lead stage × 100

  • blog.hubspot.com · Reference 1 ↗
Read the definition & analysis →

Opportunity win rate

Closed-won opportunities ÷ (closed-won opportunities + closed-lost opportunities) × 100

  • blog.hubspot.com · Reference 1 ↗
Read the definition & analysis →

Average won-deal sales cycle

Sum of (closed-won timestamp − opportunity-created timestamp) in days ÷ number of closed-won opportunities

  • knowledge.hubspot.com · Reference 1 ↗
Read the definition & analysis →

Average first meaningful response time

Sum of minutes from lead arrival to first qualifying response ÷ number of responded valid leads

  • knowledge.hubspot.com · Reference 1 ↗
Read the definition & analysis →

Fully loaded customer acquisition cost (CAC)

Total allocated acquisition sales and marketing costs ÷ new paying customers acquired by that cost scope

  • stripe.com · Reference 1 ↗
Read the definition & analysis →

Return on ad spend (ROAS)

Attributed net sales revenue ÷ attributed media spend

  • support.google.com · Reference 1 ↗
Read the definition & analysis →

Campaign contribution after media

Attributed net sales revenue − attributable non-media variable costs − attributed media spend

  • stripe.com · Reference 1 ↗
Read the definition & analysis →

Media break-even ROAS

1 ÷ pre-media contribution margin fraction; margin fraction = (net sales − non-media variable costs) ÷ net sales

  • stripe.com · Reference 1 ↗
Read the definition & analysis →

Simplified gross-profit lifetime value (LTV)

Monthly average revenue per paying customer × gross-margin fraction ÷ monthly customer-churn fraction

  • stripe.com · Reference 1 ↗
  • stripe.com · Reference 2 ↗
Read the definition & analysis →

Gross-profit CAC payback period

Fully loaded CAC ÷ (monthly average revenue per new customer × gross-margin fraction)

  • stripe.com · Reference 1 ↗
Read the definition & analysis →

Monthly recurring revenue (MRR)

Sum of qualifying subscription recurring amounts normalized to one month; annual recurring amount ÷ 12

  • stripe.com · Reference 1 ↗
Read the definition & analysis →

Monthly customer churn rate

Starting-month paying customer accounts lost by month end ÷ paying customer accounts at month start × 100

  • stripe.com · Reference 1 ↗
Read the definition & analysis →

Customer cohort retention rate

Starting-cohort paying accounts remaining at period end ÷ paying accounts in the starting cohort × 100

  • stripe.com · Reference 1 ↗
Read the definition & analysis →

Seven-day activation rate

Eligible signup-cohort accounts completing the milestone within seven days ÷ eligible accounts in that signup cohort × 100

  • amplitude.com · Reference 1 ↗
Read the definition & analysis →

Trial-to-paid conversion rate

Trial-cohort accounts becoming paying by the deadline ÷ eligible unique trial accounts in that cohort × 100

  • amplitude.com · Reference 1 ↗
  • amplitude.com · Reference 2 ↗
Read the definition & analysis →

Average task completion time

Total elapsed completion minutes for successful eligible tasks ÷ number of successful eligible tasks

  • docs.n8n.io · Reference 1 ↗
Read the definition & analysis →

Estimated net human time saved

(Baseline manual minutes per equivalent task × successful automated tasks − actual review, rework, and maintenance minutes) ÷ 60
